facts.statement: Stomach contents from Early Jurassic Germany suggest Lepidotes fed on soft-bodied prey, grasping it with slender marginal teeth and crushing it with rounded palatal teeth.

facts.statement: Woodward identified many characteristics in 1895, including a moderately compressed fusiform trunk, compressed marginal teeth, smooth stouter inner teeth, ossified ribs, very large fin-fulcrums, small paired fins, short deep dorsal and anal fins, robust scales, and inconspicuous dorsal and ventral ridge-scales.
